qualifier: norepinephrine and dopamine transporter (SLC6A2/SLC6A3) function and defects
name: Norepinephrine and dopamine transporter-mediated neurotransmitter reuptake
rationale: All members concern transporter-mediated neurotransmitter uptake/loading, centred on SLC6A2/SLC6A3 and their disease defects, which distinguishes it from confusables built on generic catecholamine transport terms and monoamine synthesis/degradation.

core: T cell receptor signalling and T cell activation
qualifier: CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
name: TCR signalling and CD28 costimulation in T cell activation
rationale: Members cover proximal and downstream TCR signalling, CD28 costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition and T cell activation, distinguishing it from BCR-signalling and T/B development module confusables.

qualifier: cranial sensory nerves and olfactory-derived GnRH neuron migration
name: Ear, nose and cranial sensory nerve development
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of ear and nose structures plus olfactory/vestibulocochlear nerves, cranial ganglia and olfactory-placode GnRH neuron migration, setting it apart from eye, gland and general craniofacial confusables.

qualifier: glutamate and GABA release modulated by presynaptic receptors and G proteins
name: Presynaptic modulation of glutamate and GABA release
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic calcium, membrane potential and vesicle exocytosis governing glutamate/GABA release (mGluR, kainate, GABA, Gbeta/gamma), distinguishing it from postsynaptic ionotropic receptor and vesicle release-cycle confusables.

core: Regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial proliferation
qualifier: negative control of FGF production and FGF chemotaxis
name: Sprouting angiogenesis regulation and FGF suppression
rationale: Members regulate vessel sprouting, branching and endothelial proliferation together with suppression of FGF production and FGF chemotaxis, which the VEGF, Tie and endothelial-activation confusables lack.

qualifier: nuclear transcriptional response, with progesterone receptor
name: Nuclear estrogen and progesterone receptor transcriptional response
rationale: Members are estrogen response gene programmes, estrogen-dependent nuclear events and progesterone receptor signalling, distinguishing it from androgen receptor confusables and the GPER1/estrous cycle confusable.

qualifier: classical and alternative pathway activation
name: Complement activation via classical and alternative pathways
rationale: All members describe complement activation, with classical antibody-mediated and alternative pathway activation distinguishing it from negative-regulation and lectin/C3-C5 confusables.

core: Organic ion and xenobiotic transmembrane transport
qualifier: xenobiotic export including blood-brain barrier, organic cations
name: Xenobiotic export and organic cation/anion transport
rationale: Members cover organic cation/anion and xenobiotic transmembrane transport including efflux at the blood-brain barrier, distinguishing it from drug ADME/SLCO and monocarboxylate/dicarboxylate confusables.

qualifier: Sema3A-plexin signalling via CRMPs and microtubule destabilisation
name: Sema3A-plexin axon repulsion and nerve branching
rationale: Members are Sema3A-plexin repulsive signalling (CRMPs, PAK, integrin inhibition, microtubule depolymerisation) and nerve branching, distinguishing it from netrin, ephrin and collateral sprouting confusables.

qualifier: glutathione and selenium compound metabolism
name: Sulfur amino acid, glutathione and selenium compound metabolism
rationale: Members span transsulfuration, cysteine/sulfide catabolism, glutathione synthesis/recycling defects and selenium compound metabolism, distinguishing it from carnitine/choline, aromatic amino acid and urea cycle confusables.

qualifier: regulation of nucleotide biosynthesis
name: Nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphate interconversion and its regulation
rationale: Members concern phosphorylation interconverting nucleoside mono/di/triphosphates (ADP, GTP) and regulation of nucleotide biosynthesis, distinguishing it from pyrophosphate/inositol pyrophosphate, NAD and creatine confusables.

qualifier: ADP signalling through P2Y1 and P2Y12 purinoceptors
name: ADP-P2Y purinoceptor platelet activation
rationale: All members describe ADP/P2Y1/P2Y12-driven platelet activation, which distinguishes it from GPVI, GP1b-IX-V and integrin platelet activation confusables.

qualifier: REM/non-REM sleep and orexin neuropeptide signalling
name: Sleep-wake state regulation and orexin neuropeptide signalling
rationale: Members regulate sleep, REM/non-REM states and wakefulness with orexin neuropeptide receptor binding, distinguishing it from generic neuropeptide, feeding, social behaviour and circadian transcription confusables.

qualifier: IGF2BP/CRD stabilisation and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
name: mRNA stabilization by IGF2BPs and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
rationale: Members balance mRNA stabilisation (IGF2BPs, CRD, 3'-UTR) against decapping and 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay, distinguishing it from deadenylation, NMD and ARE-binding destabilisation confusables.

qualifier: heart tube and second heart field
name: Embryonic heart tube and second heart field morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover heart tube morphogenesis and laterality, second heart field specification/proliferation and ventricle formation, distinguishing it from conduction system, valve/cushion, myocardial maturation and outflow tract confusables.

qualifier: EGFR and ERBB2 adaptor-mediated downstream events
name: EGFR and ERBB2 adaptor-mediated downstream signalling
rationale: Members are EGFR/ERBB2 signalling via GRB2, SHC1, PI3K, PLCG1, GRB7 and GAB1 plus EGFR transactivation, distinguishing it from ERBB3/ERBB4 and MET signalling confusables.

qualifier: NICD-driven transcription and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants
name: Notch intracellular domain transcriptional signalling and oncogenic NOTCH1
rationale: Members describe Notch receptor processing, NOTCH1-4 intracellular domain target transcription and constitutive NOTCH1 cancer mutants, distinguishing it from NOTCH4-only, ERBB4 and p75NTR intramembrane proteolysis confusables.

qualifier: acyl-chain remodelling and DAG/MAG/endocannabinoid metabolism
name: Glycerophospholipid synthesis, acyl-chain remodeling and acylglycerol-endocannabinoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis and acyl-chain remodelling of PA, PC, PE, PS, PG and CL plus DAG/MAG turnover and endocannabinoid signalling, distinguishing it from sphingolipid, lipid transfer and triglyceride lipolysis confusables.

qualifier: Wnt ligand secretion and Rab geranylgeranylation
name: Wnt ligand secretion and Rab geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members combine PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis/secretion with Rab prenylation and activation at the Golgi, distinguishing it from hedgehog palmitoylation and RAS processing confusables.

qualifier: stress-induced repression of translational initiation
name: Unfolded protein response translational initiation repression
rationale: Members are the unfolded protein response and stress-regulated translational initiation, distinguishing it from ATF4, ATF6 and XBP1 transcriptional UPR confusables.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated genes and ISG15 conjugation
name: Type I interferon-stimulated gene response with ISG15 conjugation
rationale: Members are type I IFN/ISG signatures, IRF2 target networks and ISG15 antiviral conjugation, distinguishing it from OAS/PKR, viral restriction and RIG-I sensing confusables.

qualifier: RNA processing, modification, stability and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification, stability and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial tRNA/mRNA/rRNA processing, modification, decay and import plus mitoribosome assembly, distinguishing it from nuclear tRNA processing, mitochondrial translation/transcription and pseudouridylation confusables.

qualifier: negative regulation of TGF-beta response and matrix assembly
name: Wound connective tissue repair with TGF-beta and matrix restraint
rationale: Members are connective tissue replacement in wound healing plus negative regulation of TGF-beta response and extracellular matrix assembly, distinguishing it from fibroblast/myofibroblast and endothelial confusables.

qualifier: nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching
rationale: Members describe nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching, distinguishing it from metanephric mesenchyme proliferation/apoptosis and intermediate mesoderm confusables.

qualifier: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium transport
name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium transport
rationale: Members cover erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO transport and Rh glycoprotein-mediated ammonium transport, distinguishing it from heme biosynthesis, iron homeostasis and surfactant confusables.
